actor_metadata.authoring_description: A 2D faceted humanoid brawler built as the unarmed companion to the Fighting Polygon sword reference rig. Its deliberately plain anatomy, large polygon fists, and conservative clip library make it a safe pose source for future humanoid characters before bespoke anatomy or personality is introduced.
actor_metadata.gameplay_description: Use as a fundamentals brawler and humanoid animation reference: close-range strikes, uppercuts, shoulder rushes, defensive movement, grabs, pummels, and all four throws.

asset_metadata.purpose: safe humanoid brawler pose reference + playable Smash fighter
asset_metadata.pose_source: shared Fighting Polygon humanoid clip vocabulary; brawler art and gameplay are independent

build_provenance.note: Skeleton/clip transforms are intentionally shared between the two reference archetypes. The brawler owns distinct SVG art and gameplay and has no integral weapon part.
